column2: [intro]
I discovered something quite surreal,
Ugly things that turn into a big deal.
I must say, it’s truly surprising,
How the ugly can be so mesmerizing.
The ugly becomes cool, the plain is the trend,
Imperfections are now the thing to commend.
In this crazy world, we find bold grace,
That’s what makes life a fun-filled place.
I took an old sock with a hole,
And turned it into a trendy goal.
Everyone asks where I got this gem,
It’s from my closet, where all things are welcome!
The ugly becomes cool, the plain is the trend,
Imperfections are now the thing to commend.
In this crazy world, we find bold grace,
That’s what makes life a fun-filled place.
[ solo ]
So sing with me this funky tune,
Forget the rules, let’s all be a little kooky soon.
The ugly becomes cool, yeah, it’s true,
In this quirky song, we find beauty too.
[outro]
